out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Signage
violations.observation: Observed that sign or poster that notifies food employees to wash their hands is not provided or is not clearly visible at all handwashing sinks used by food employees. There was no signage at the sink in the back prep room.
violations.corrective_action: Provide a visible sign or poster at all handwashing sinks used by food employees that reminds food employees to wash their hands. The PIC corrected this during the inspection.

out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Storage of Poison/Toxic Materials
violations.observation: Observed that poisonous and toxic materials are not properly stored to prevent the contamination of food, equipment, utensils, linens or single service items. Quaternary ammonia tablets and oven cleaner were stored above and on the same counter with waffle making equipment behind the front counter. Quaternary ammonia tablets were also stored with clean equipment and over the three compartment sink
violations.corrective_action: All poisonous and toxic materials shall be stored below food, equipment, utensils, linens, and single service items to prevent contamination. The PIC moved all these improperly stored chemicals during the inspection to correct.

violations.title: Poison/Toxic Material, Conditions of Use
violations.observation: Pesticides labeled for residential use were observed in the facility and are being applied by the operator to control pests. A spray can of ant and roach killer was observed stored with the establishment chemicals.
violations.corrective_action: Remove residential use pesticides from the facility. When necessary for pest control, chemical pesticides must be applied by a certified pesticide applicator to prevent injury and contamination. The PIC removed the ant and roach killer during the inspection to correct.

out_items.name: Person in charge present, demonstrates knowledge, and performs duties

violations.title: DOK Clean and Sanitize
violations.observation: The certified food manager was not aware that all equipment and utensils must be washed, rinsed and sanitized before being used.
violations.corrective_action: The person in charge shall know that all utensils and food contact surfaces of equipment shall be 1) washed with hot, soapy water to remove visible soil, 2) rinsed to remove residue, 3) sanitized using an approved sanitizer to reduce the number of bacteria and viruses and 4) air dried. The EHS discussed this requirement with the person in charge and showed them how to set up and use the three compartment sink properly.

violations.title: Permit to Operate Posted in Conspicuous Location
violations.observation: The establishment’s 2025 health department permit was not posted and the person in charge could not locate it
violations.corrective_action: A valid permit shall be posted in every food establishment in a conspicuous place in the public view. Food establishment permits are issued for a calendar year and expire on December 31 regardless of the month of issue. The EHS will request that a duplicate permit be mailed to the establishment. Once received, please post the permit in a conspicuous location.

out_items.name: Management, food employee and conditional employee; knowledge, responsibilities and reporting

violations.title: Duty of PIC, Employee Health Policy in Place
violations.observation: Upon discussion with the person-in-charge, one or more of the elements of an effective employee health policy is either missing or incomplete. A complete employee health policy is required to be in place at the food establishment. At the time of this inspection, the Health Department provided and reviewed handouts and resource information in a red folder labeled 'Employee Health Policy.' The person in charge was not able to locate the establishment employee health policy.
violations.corrective_action: A complete employee health policy must have the following elements: 1) Employee training on foodborne illness, particularly symptoms of illness and prevention of the Big Six illnesses (see 'What is Foodborne Illness' handout); and 2) Documentation that employees have been instructed of their responsibility to report symptoms of, diagnosis of or exposure to foodborne illness to management (see 'Employee Illness Reporting Agreement' handout); and 3) A management plan to restrict or exclude employees, as applicable, who have symptoms, diagnosis or exposure to foodborne illness (see 'Employee Illness Decision Guide for PIC/CFM' handout). The information provided at the time of this inspection will help you develop and implement this policy. Handouts are available in the following languages: English, Arabic, Chinese (traditional), Farsi, Hindi, Korean, Spanish, Thai, Urdu and Vietnamese. If you have any questions about your employee health policy, please contact your area inspector or contact the Health Department at 703-246-2201, TTY 703-591-6435. The EHS emailed copies of the Employee Health Policy to the owner. Please train staff on it as required and have them sign the forms in time for the follow-up.

out_items.name: Procedures for responding to vomiting and diarrheal events

violations.title: Clean-up of vomiting and diarrheal events
violations.observation: The food establishment does not have written procedures for employees to follow when responding to vomiting or diarrheal events. The per person in charge cannot locate the vomiting or diarrhea event policy.
violations.corrective_action: A food establishment shall have written procedures for employees to follow when responding to vomiting or diarrheal events that involve the discharge of vomitus or fecal matter onto surfaces in the food establishment. The procedures shall address the specific actions employees must take to minimize the spread of contamination and the exposure of employees, consumers, food and surfaces to vomitus or fecal matter. The EHS emailed employee health policy to the owner. Please implement this policy by the follow up inspection.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Paper Towels Provided
violations.observation: Observed that paper towels were not provided at each handwashing sink. There are no paper towels at the sink in the back of the establishment.
violations.corrective_action: Provide paper towels at each hand sink to allow employees to properly dry their hands after handwashing. The person in charge corrected this during the inspection.

out_items.name: Food-contact surfaces cleaned and sanitized

violations.title: Before Use After Cleaning
violations.observation: The person in charge did not properly sanitize ice cream scoops after washing them.
violations.corrective_action: All utensils and food-contact surfaces of equipment shall be sanitized before use and after cleaning. The EHS helped set up the three compartment sink and educated the person in charge on how all food equipment and utensils need to be sanitized before use.

out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Sanitizers, Criteria
violations.observation: The concentration of the quaternary ammonia wiping cloth sanitizer solution was measured at 500 ppm. This concentration exceeds the approved limits for use with food-contact surfaces of equipment and utensils in a foodservice establishment.
violations.corrective_action: Maintain the concentration of this solution at 200-400 ppm. Verify concentration using the appropriate test kit. This was corrected by adding water to the solution. The final concentration was 200 parts per million.

violations.title: Storage of Poison/Toxic Materials
violations.observation: Observed a bottle of Shout stain remover stored with food on the storage shelves across from the rec compartment sink.
violations.corrective_action: All poisonous and toxic materials shall be stored below food, equipment, utensils, linens, and single service items to prevent contamination. The person in charge moved the Shout during the inspection to correct.

out_items.name: Thermometers provided and accurate

violations.title: Food Thermometers, Provided & Accessible
violations.observation: The certified food manager could not provide a food temperature measuring device.
violations.corrective_action: A metal-stemmed probe food thermometer shall be provided and readily accessible for use in ensuring attainment and maintenance of food temperatures. Please obtain a food thermometer before the follow up.

out_items.name: Food properly labeled, original container

violations.title: Food Storage Container, Common Name
violations.observation: The following food items that are not easily identified by appearance were observed without a label: there were two bottles of yellow food flavoring or coloring in squeeze bottles or other bottles that were not labeled.
violations.corrective_action: Unless a food item can be easily recognized, all foods and ingredients removed from their original containers and stored in working containers shall be labeled using the common name of the food. For example: cooking oils, salt, sugar, flour, spices, herbs, etc. Ensure all food containers are labeled, especially ones that are removed from original packaging to avoid misuse before the follow up.

out_items.name: In-use utensils properly stored

violations.title: In-Use Utensils Proper Storage
violations.observation: Dispensing and/or in-use utensils improperly stored between use as follows: in use ice cream scoops were being stored in the sink behind the counter. The person in charge stated she dips them in the heated dipper well, which was 160 degrees, before using.
violations.corrective_action: During pauses in food preparation or dispensing, food utensils shall be stored in one of the following manners: 1) in the food with their handles above the top of the food and the container, 2) in food that is not time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food with their handles above the top of the food within containers or equipment that can be closed, 3) on a clean portion of the food preparation table or cooking equipment only if the in-use utensil and the food contact surface of the food preparation table or cooking equipment are cleaned and sanitized, 4) in running water of sufficient velocity to flush particulates to the drain, 5) in a clean, protected location if the utensils are used only with a food that is NOT TCS food, or 6) in a container of water if the water is maintained at a temperature of at least 135F and the container is cleaned frequently. The EHS explained to the person in charge that the ice cream scoops must be stored in a clean location between uses and that the heated dipper wells were in need of cleaning due to debris and deposit built-ups. Clean the heated dipperwells before the follow-up.

out_items.name: Warewashing facilities installed, maintained and used; test strips

violations.title: Test Kit/Device for Chemical Sanitizer
violations.observation: There is no test kit located in the facility for monitoring the concentration of the chemical sanitizing solutions.
violations.corrective_action: Obtain a QUATERNARY AMMONIA test kit before the follow-up. MIMI'S HANDMADE ICE CREAM (Inspection Date: 10/20/2025) Page 2 of 4

out_items.name: Plumbing installed, proper backflow devices

violations.title: Backflow Prevention, Approved Device Provided
violations.observation: Observed a hose with a spray nozzle connected to the mop sink without the proper backflow protection.
violations.corrective_action: A plumbing system shall be installed to preclude backflow of a solid, liquid, or gas contaminant into the water supply system at each point of use at the food establishment, including on a hose bib if a hose is attached or on a hose bib if a hose is not attached and backflow prevention is required by Law by installing an approved backflow prevention device as specified under 5-202.14. The person in charge disconnected the hose to correct. The EHS sent the owner an example of the correct hose bibb spigot backflow preventer (a Hydro Systems 1951 Pressure Bleed Dual Valve, image attached to this message) to install on the mopsink. Install prior to the follow-up.

out_items.name: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Maintain Good Repair
violations.observation: Observed an out of order sign on the single restroom provided in the establishment. The person in charge explained that the door lock on the bathroom door is broken.
violations.corrective_action: Repair the physical facilities. Poor repair and maintenance compromises the functionality of the physical facilities. Repair the door lock before the follow up inspection. Establishments that provide seating are required to provide a restroom.

out_items.name: Certified Food Protection Manager

violations.title: Food Protection Manager - Accredited Program
violations.observation: It shall be unlawful to operate a food establishment unless it is under the immediate control of a certified food manager who has shown proficiency through passing an accredited examination.
violations.corrective_action: Obtain a certified food managers certificate from an accredited program. CFM arrived during the inspection.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Signage
violations.observation: Observed that sign or poster that notifies food employees to wash their hands is not provided or is not clearly visible at all handwashing sinks used by food employees. Handwash sign missing at hand sink by 3 compartment sink and front hand sink.
violations.corrective_action: Provide a visible sign or poster at all handwashing sinks used by food employees that reminds food employees to wash their hands. Provided Handwash signs.

out_items.name: Proper date marking and disposition

violations.title: RTE TCS Commercially Processed Food, Date Marking
violations.observation: The following refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety food that is commercially processed is not used or discarded within 24 hours of when the original container was opened and is not observed to be date marked: waffle batter
violations.corrective_action: Refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety commercially processed foods when opened and kept for more than 24 hours cannot have a shelf-life of more than 7 days, including the day of the original container was opened. These food items must be marked with either the 'consume-by' date and/or 'preparation' date, color-coded labels, or another marking system/method that effectively indicates shelf-life that is clearly understood and properly used by the employees. This date cannot exceed any manufacturer determined 'use-by' date based on food safety. PIC provided the date mark.

out_items.name: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage, and display

violations.title: Distressed Food Segregated
violations.observation: Products for credit, redemption, or return are not being stored in a separate designated area. Observed two dented cans of ube on the storage rack.
violations.corrective_action: Store damaged and/or spoiled products in a separate and segregated area to preclude the mistaken use of these products. Discarded product.

violations.title: Food Storage 6 inches above Floor
violations.observation: Food stored on the floor and/or food stored less than 6 inches off the floor. Observed flavoring on the floor in the office and cones on the floor in the front.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from contamination by storing the food at least 6 inches off the floor on approved shelving units or dunnage racks. Milk crates, soda crates, or bread racks are not suitable for food storage.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, Durable/Smooth Materials
violations.observation: The nonfood-contact surface of the following equipment is not corrosion resistant, nonabsorbent, and/or smooth: shelf above 3 compartment sink wrapped in bubble wrap.
violations.corrective_action: Non-food contact surfaces of equipment that are exposed to splash, spillage, or other foods that require frequent cleaning shall be constructed of a corrosion- resistant, nonabsorbent, and smooth material. Removed bubble wrap. MIMI'S HANDMADE ICE CREAM (Inspection Date: 11/26/2024) Page 2 of 3

out_items.name: Plumbing installed, proper backflow devices

violations.title: Backflow Prevention, Design Features
violations.observation: The backflow or backsiphonage prevention device installed on the mop sink is not identified as meeting standards set by the American Society of Sanitary Engineering. System is under continuous pressure due to hose sprayer attachment.
violations.corrective_action: A backflow or back siphonage prevention device installed on a water supply system shall meet American Society of Sanitary Engineering (A.S.S.E.) standards for construction, installation, maintenance, inspection, and testing for that specific application and type of device. Removed hose for, mop sink. Please replace with correct device.
